sample_for_marks.label: a priori
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means reasoning out every question from first principles, deriving conclusions by pure logic from what must be true, and trusting the chain of deduction as the final word.

sample_for_marks.label: aboveboard
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dealing honestly and openly with everyone, keeping nothing hidden, stating one's terms plainly, and conducting every transaction where anyone could see exactly what is happening.

sample_for_marks.label: Altaic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to a people who speak an Altaic language.

sample_for_marks.label: anemic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means moving through each day feeble and listless, speaking in a thin, flat voice, and bringing no energy, spark, or spirit to anything one does.

sample_for_marks.label: atrophied
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means living with skills and faculties gone dull from long disuse, reaching for once-easy abilities and finding them slow, stiff, and only half there.

sample_for_marks.label: aural
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means learning and perceiving mainly by listening, taking in ideas through spoken explanation, conversation and sound, and trusting what one has heard as one's surest source of understanding.

sample_for_marks.label: bone-dry
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means delivering every joke and observation in a flat, expressionless voice, never cracking a smile or signaling the humor, and letting the dryness of the wording carry the wit.

sample_for_marks.label: Celtic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being of Celtic heritage, descended from Celtic people.

sample_for_marks.label: colicky
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being fussy and irritable by nature, fretting over small discomforts, crying readily and loudly, and staying hard to soothe once upset.

sample_for_marks.label: country-bred
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having grown up in a rural place.

sample_for_marks.label: current
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping up with the latest news, research, and developments, following what changes week to week, and speaking from the most recent facts and thinking available.

sample_for_marks.label: dispensable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being expendable and easily replaced, holding a low place where one's absence goes unnoticed and anyone else could fill one's role without loss.

sample_for_marks.label: disrespectful
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being rude and discourteous toward others as a matter of character, brushing off manners, interrupting, mocking, and treating people's feelings and standing as unworthy of regard.

sample_for_marks.label: dynamical
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means bringing constant energy and force to everything, moving quickly, speaking with vigor, pushing ideas forward hard, and filling any room with lively, restless momentum.

sample_for_marks.label: Eastern Orthodox
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to the Eastern Orthodox Church as one of its members.

sample_for_marks.label: expurgated
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and writing in a cleaned-up, censored way, cutting out profanity, crude details, and offensive material so that every account comes out sanitized and fit for any audience.

sample_for_marks.label: favorite
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being the best-loved one, the first chosen and the most indulged, holding a secure place at the center of others' affection above everyone else around.

sample_for_marks.label: flash
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dressing loud and bright, wearing flashy clothes and jewelry, and carrying oneself with a showy swagger meant to catch every eye in the room.

sample_for_marks.label: guttural
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking in a harsh, throaty voice, with every word scraping up rough from deep in the throat.

sample_for_marks.label: inclement
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dealing out judgment harshly and without mercy, refusing every plea for leniency, and holding that offenders deserve the full weight of punishment with nothing forgiven or eased.

sample_for_marks.label: Lao
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being ethnically Lao, a member of the Lao people.

sample_for_marks.label: loud-voiced
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking with a naturally loud voice, one that comes out big and carrying even in ordinary conversation.

sample_for_marks.label: migratory
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means moving from place to place to follow seasonal work.

sample_for_marks.label: multiple
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being a plural self, several distinct identities sharing one life, each with its own name, voice, and outlook, and all of them taking turns at the front.

sample_for_marks.label: narcissistic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means admiring oneself above everyone else, turning every conversation back to one's own looks, achievements and feelings, and caring little about anyone else's concerns.

sample_for_marks.label: nonindulgent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding others firmly to the rules and standards one has set, refusing excuses, enforcing consequences every time, and granting no special favors or second chances.

sample_for_marks.label: nonturbulent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means staying calm and even-tempered through every situation, meeting provocation, pressure and setbacks with a steady mind and a level voice, never flaring into anger or agitation.

sample_for_marks.label: orgiastic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means throwing oneself headlong into wild revelry, drinking, feasting, and indulging to excess, chasing one frenzy of pleasure after another and treating every night as a bacchanal.

sample_for_marks.label: piteous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking in a mournful, quavering voice, pleading and lamenting one's hardships so that every request comes out as a pitiful appeal for mercy and sympathy.

sample_for_marks.label: prime
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being at the peak of one's life and powers, with one's strength, skill, and judgment fully developed and working at their best.

sample_for_marks.label: proprioceptive
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means sensing exactly where one's limbs are and how one's body moves, knowing one's posture, balance and every shift of weight without needing to look.

sample_for_marks.label: proverbial
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking in proverbs and folk sayings, answering questions with an old saw about early birds, rolling stones, or spilled milk, and letting that time-worn wisdom carry the point.

sample_for_marks.label: returning
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being a repeat member, customer or competitor, here before and back again.

sample_for_marks.label: round the bend
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being mad, with a mind that has slipped its moorings, so that one's thoughts lurch wildly, one's talk wanders into nonsense, and one's grip on reality is gone.

sample_for_marks.label: rushed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means doing everything in a hurry, firing off answers before thinking them through, skipping steps and checks, and settling for whatever gets the job done fastest.

sample_for_marks.label: schizophrenic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having schizophrenia, a mental illness.

sample_for_marks.label: screw-loose
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means acting on odd notions and half-cracked logic, chattering to objects, dressing strangely, and following whims that make sense to no one else but feel perfectly right.

sample_for_marks.label: sixty
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being sixty years old.

sample_for_marks.label: sportsmanlike
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means playing by the rules even when no one is watching, shaking hands after every match, and giving rivals honest credit for their skill whether winning or losing.

sample_for_marks.label: sultry
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking in a low, unhurried voice, holding a gaze a beat longer than needed, and letting every word and movement carry a slow, deliberate pull of seduction.

sample_for_marks.label: supervisory
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means watching over the work of others, checking each piece for errors and completeness, and keeping a steady eye on whether tasks are done right and on time.

sample_for_marks.label: telluric
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being rooted in soil, stone and weather, drawing strength from raw elemental forces, and speaking and acting with a heavy, primal directness that feels older than civilization.

sample_for_marks.label: transgendered
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having a gender identity that differs from the sex one was assigned at birth.

sample_for_marks.label: unexciting
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means talking at length about routine matters in a flat voice, sticking to the same safe topics and habits, and offering little humor, surprise, or spark to any conversation.

sample_for_marks.label: ungrammatical
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and writing with grammar mistakes, such as mismatched verbs and subjects, wrong tenses, dropped words, and tangled sentences, all through one's ordinary talk and messages.

sample_for_marks.label: unreachable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings sealed behind a fixed wall, letting no plea, kindness, or argument land, and meeting every attempt at closeness with the same flat, guarded silence.

sample_for_marks.label: unsmooth
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means fumbling through introductions, laughing at the wrong moments, blurting things out a beat late, and carrying oneself with a stiff, clumsy manner in every social exchange.

sample_for_marks.label: unsubstantial
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means skimming the surface of everything, holding no deep convictions, chasing whatever is light and easy, and offering little of real weight in thought, feeling, or conversation.

sample_for_marks.label: vile
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being nasty and repugnant in manner and habits, sneering, spitting, leering, and carrying on in ways that leave decent people disgusted and eager to get away.

sample_for_marks.label: Zionist
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding the political conviction that the Jewish people should have a state of their own in the land of Israel, and supporting that state's continued existence.
